items.title: 🚨 Anthropic vient de dévoiler claude fable 5.2.
items.summary:
🚨 Anthropic vient de dévoiler claude fable 5.2.

Et il est tout simplement SURPUISSANT !

voici ce qu’il est désormais capable de faire.

1. construire des logiciels entièrement à partir de zéro

un ingénieur d’anthropic lui a demandé de concevoir un système d’exploitation à partir d’un dossier vide.

fable 5.2 a coordonné plus de 1 000 sous-agents pendant huit jours.

résultat : un système d’exploitation fonctionnel, capable de démarrer sur un ordinateur portable, avec :

son propre noyau
des pilotes pour le clavier, le disque et le réseau
un système de stockage permanent
une interface graphique avec fenêtres
un écran de connexion
un programme d’installation

il ne s’est pas contenté de générer du code.

il a organisé le travail, réparti les tâches, testé les composants et coordonné leur intégration.

2. automatiser des migrations informatiques complexes

une équipe d’agents utilisant une version précédente de fable 5.2 a migré un service critique de production de Python vers Rust.

le nouveau service est devenu plus efficace et plus fiable.

son démarrage est désormais environ 26 fois plus rapide.

ce type de travail mobilise habituellement des ingénieurs expérimentés, du temps et des ressources importantes.

3. formaliser le dernier théorème de Fermat

c’est probablement l’une des démonstrations les plus impressionnantes.

une équipe de 1 000 agents fable 5.2 a réussi à formaliser intégralement le dernier théorème de Fermat dans Lean en seulement 30 heures.

la formalisation consiste à traduire une démonstration mathématique dans un langage vérifiable par ordinateur.

le système a construit ses propres mécanismes de coordination et progressé avec une intervention humaine minimale.

à titre de comparaison, Opus 5.5 n’avait réalisé qu’environ 26 % du travail après 18 heures dans la même configuration expérimentale.

4. concevoir des objets électroniques

fable 5.2 ne se limite plus au développement logiciel.

anthropic rapporte que le modèle a conçu trois appareils électroniques fonctionnels à partir de zéro.

il est capable de travailler sur des problématiques de conception matérielle, de géométrie et de circuits électroniques.

il obtient notamment un score de 83,5 sur BenchCAD 2.1, contre 65,3 pour Opus 5.5.

5. faire progresser la robotique

le modèle montre également des progrès importants dans le contrôle de robots physiques.

il peut notamment :

résoudre un casse-tête avec un robot
dévisser un bouchon
dessiner une image
manipuler des objets à partir d’informations visuelles

sur le benchmark RoboDojo, qui évalue le contrôle d’un robot simulé à deux bras, il atteint 64,9 %.

soit plus du double du score obtenu par GPT-6 Astra dans les tests comparatifs présentés par Anthropic.

6. conduire des recherches complexes

fable 5.2 peut également prendre en charge des recherches nécessitant plusieurs étapes.

il est capable de :

collecter et analyser de grandes quantités de données
écrire du code pour tester des hypothèses
coordonner plusieurs agents spécialisés
organiser des expériences
interpréter les résultats
produire des conclusions structurées

l’objectif est de réduire considérablement le travail de coordination et d’exécution qui incombe actuellement aux chercheurs et aux analystes.

7. travailler sur des projets pendant plusieurs heures

c’est peut-être sa caractéristique la plus importante.

fable 5.2 dispose d’une fenêtre de contexte d’un million de tokens et peut produire jusqu’à 128 000 tokens en sortie.

il est conçu pour maintenir un travail complexe sur une longue durée, sans devoir repartir de zéro à chaque étape.

il peut ainsi transformer une demande ambitieuse en un projet structuré, déléguer des sous-tâches, vérifier les résultats et poursuivre jusqu’à obtenir un livrable exploitable.

…⤵️

items.summary:
我不会真被灰度到 GPT-6.2 Sol 了吧？

讲道理，6.1 是不知道 Fable 5 的。群友拿 API 里的 gpt-6.1-sol 问，它只想得到 F# 那个编译器和同名游戏。另一位群友的 ChatGPT 也说不知道具体指什么。

我这边同样不让搜索，它直接认出是 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5。嘴上说对发布情况没把握，一问发布日期却直接报了出来：2026 年 6 月 9 日。

items.title: Sachverhaltsprüfung: GPT 6 Astra, Aufwand: „max", parallel, mit demselben Kontext: Fable 5, Aufwand „sehr hoch".
items.summary:
Sachverhaltsprüfung: GPT 6 Astra, Aufwand: „max", parallel, mit demselben Kontext: Fable 5, Aufwand „sehr hoch".

Danach Querprüfung: Astra kriegt die Analyse von Fable, Fable arbeitet die Analyse von Astra ab.

Danach: händisch Paragraphen, Normen, Urteile und Co. checken.

Dann: Den ersten Entwurf schreibt Astra -> ich lese und übergebe an Fable meine Einwände -> Fable schreibt neu.

Finetuning mit GPT 5.6 „pro" oder „sehr hoch".

Der fertige Schriftsatz wird komplett, inklusive aller Anlagen, mit GPT 6 Astra, Aufwand: „max", geprüft. Häufig auch zwei mal: 1x im ursprünglichen Chat/Workspace, 1x - in einem neuen Chat/Workspace ohne Kontext.

Kleine Anwendungen, wie z. B. für die Handhabung riesiger JSON-Dateien oder HTML-Exporte, schreibt SuperGrok.

Will ich jammern, jammere ich ins Gemini Pro 3.1 „high".

Also: klare Aufgabenteilung 👍

items.title: From scans to scribes, Yale medical faculty talk AI use in healthcare | Yale Daily News
items.summary:
Normally, diagnosing prostate cancer includes a blood test, MRI imaging and a formal diagnosis from a radiologist, who might read the same MRI image differently on different days.

Now, Onofrey said, he and other researchers are training deep learning models on these images to look for diseases including prostate cancer, though he said researchers have not validated models in large enough settings for clinical adoption yet. [...] Technology companies will face skepticism, according to Papademetris. Many AI models remain “black box” models, meaning users do not know the details of the inner workings behind the AI used in practice.

Though scientific advancement is exciting, Papademetris cautioned about implementing AI into healthcare without the proper guardrails in place. [...] Some provider systems, such as Yale Health, have incorporated AI scribes to help draft notes from patient visits. Yale researchers and professors spoke to the News about their experiences with AI-powered tools. Xenophon Papademetris, a professor at the School of Medicine, said people should be skeptical of AI use in everyday clinical practice.

items.title: Có Nên Học Công Nghệ Thông Tin? Học CNTT Có Khó Không?
items.summary:
## Ai Phù Hợp Với Ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin?

Ngành Công nghệ thông tin phù hợp với người yêu thích công nghệ, có tư duy logic, kiên trì giải quyết vấn đề và sẵn sàng tự học. Không nhất thiết phải biết lập trình trước khi vào đại học, nhưng học sinh nên có hứng thú tìm hiểu cách các hệ thống máy tính và ứng dụng hoạt động.

### Những Tố Chất Phù Hợp Với Ngành CNTT

Dưới đy là một số đặc điểm có thể giúp học sinh học tập và phát triển trong ngành. [...] Có nên học Công nghệ thông tin? Học CNTT có khó không? Đy là những băn khoăn phổ biến của học sinh THPT khi đứng trước lựa chọn ngành học. Công nghệ thông tin (CNTT) vẫn có nhiều hướng nghề nghiệp trong lĩnh vực phần mềm, dữ liệu, bảo mật và hệ thống máy tính. Tuy nhiên, ngành học này đòi hỏi khả năng tư duy logic, kiên trì thực hành và chủ động cập nhật kiến thức. Để quyết định có nên học CNTT, học sinh cần nhìn nhận thực tế thị trường việc làm, độ khó của chương trình và mức độ phù hợp với [...] Nên học Công nghệ thông tin nếu bạn yêu thích công nghệ, có khả năng tư duy logic và sẵn sàng dành thời gian học tập, thực hành lu dài. Ngành CNTT phù hợp với người muốn sử dụng máy tính và phần mềm để giải quyết vấn đề thực tế, không chỉ với những học sinh đã biết lập trình từ THPT.

Tuy nhiên, quyết định chọn ngành cần dựa trên sở thích, năng lực và mục tiêu nghề nghiệp thay vì kỳ vọng rằng học CNTT chắc chắn có thu nhập cao.

### Những Lý Do Nên Cn Nhắc Ngành Công Nghệ Thông Tin

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are coming for the development workflow | InfoWorld
items.summary: This is clearly where the frontier labs are moving, even though they’ve all benefited from an industry that provided neutral spaces to build. For example, OpenAI developed Pando, a Git back end for its own monorepo, to handle more engineers and agents reading and writing code concurrently. Its engineers kept using Git. OpenAI retained compatibility with the protocol and client and contributed improvements upstream. That compatibility let it rebuild the back end around the way its engineers [...] This pressure to maximize profitability helps explain why frontier labs like Anthropic and OpenAI are aggressively adding functionality to own more of the developer’s workflow. On November 4, OpenAI announced an agreement to buy Pierre, the company behind Code Storage and the open source libraries Codex already uses to browse files and review changes. OpenAI wants Codex to be where developers work, from the first branch an agent creates through deployment of the application. There’s money in [...] OpenAI or Anthropic could build the place developers prefer to work. The question is what happens when a team likes that place and wants a rival’s agent for a particular job. Maybe a startup has built a tool that can track down the intermittent test failure that’s had the team stumped for a week. Give it access to the code and test history the team has authorized, and it gets a chance to prove itself. Ask the team to move its work to a new platform first, and it probably never gets to try.
